text: Pressure on the incentive fee side operates through blackened carried interest, under which a manager cannot collect carry until all limited partners have had their capital returned within the lifetime of the private equity model.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Applications and Fee Structure Developments in Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2959730

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Applications and Fee Structure Developments in Private Investment Funds

abstract: Some industry observers are now talking about a movement towards blackened carried interest, meaning a private investment fund manager cannot collect carry until all limited partner investors have had their capital returned within the lifetime of the private equity model.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: private equity funds and, similarly, hedge funds
carry measured over the lifetime of the fund model
